subject.title: ci(qa): reuse Matrix live workflow for releases

question: After the predecessor lands, must this PR demonstrate a successful exact-head release-workflow call with Matrix status propagation before merge, or are the workflow contract tests sufficient?
rationale: The patch changes release automation and trusted reusable-workflow boundaries; static contract coverage is strong, but only the release/CI owner can accept whether it sufficiently proves the final stacked execution path.

options.title: Require exact-head release proof
options.body: Refresh the stack, obtain green test-type checks, and run the reusable release path through status aggregation before merging.

options.title: Accept contract-level proof
options.body: Land after the predecessor and green required checks based on the existing workflow contract suite without a full release-workflow invocation.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head release proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the stack, obtain green test-type checks, and run the reusable release path through status aggregation before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Matrix QA migration stack and have prior merged history in the QA evidence and workflow area.
